entities.name: Nadier
entities.description: An elf warrior sent by the Duskenel as a supposed diplomat but actually their foremost killer, tasked to train wood elves to drive off humans.

entities.name: Duskenel
entities.description: Elven nation that sent Nadier under a treaty.

events.summary: The Duskenel and wood elves sign a treaty and Nadier arrives as an apparent diplomat.
events.quote: Nadier appears to be a diplomat sent by the Duskenel

events.summary: Secretly, Nadier is tasked to train a battalion of wood elves to drive humans from the forest.
events.quote: Secretly, Nadier has been tasked to train a battalion of wood elves

relations.quote: elven solidarity far outweighs petty tribal disagreements
